service.network: separate net/mount namespace, host loopback entry, consistent with X; record relay path in each test

pool.dynamic_growth: acquisition below low watermark doubles fill target up to high watermark; do not reset or force a constant target of 1000

benchmark.only_script_change: cleanup-run warmup index fallback compares integer zero, matching the observed X user script
benchmark.stage_aggregation: associate same sandbox/request and phase; parent spans contain child spans; missing spans are unavailable, not zero
benchmark.sdk_difference_label: SDK minus server span includes SDK, networking, server work outside the span and serialization; do not label it pure HTTP

acceptance: service UID is actual local jwk UID
actual Not started FC count reaches 1000 before initial benchmark
one complete warmup then 10 measured rounds
per-round SDK and detailed span statistics in ms
record pool and host neighbor table deltas per round

host_policy.neighbor_table: read current shared IPv4 limits and errors first; preserve healthy larger limits; any necessary increase must be recorded explicitly
